Frequently Asked Questions

How do I choose the best interior designers in Chhattarpur?

Look at completed projects, not only renders. Ask how the team handles drawings, material selection and site supervision, and whether one person stays responsible for your project from concept to handover.

What kind of projects do you handle in Chhattarpur?

We design farmhouses, independent homes, apartments, offices, salons and showrooms. Each project gets its own layout, material palette and lighting plan rather than a fixed package.

Will I see the design before work starts?

Yes. You see layouts, mood boards and 3D views first. Work on site starts only after you approve the design and the materials.

What makes 9th Corner one of the best interior designers for South Delhi homes?

We stay involved from the first sketch to the final installation, so what you approve on paper is what gets built on site.
